title: Holy British Weeknight Victoria Sponge Cake
description: A salty and tender weeknight British dessert featuring jalapeno and deep-fried in a lacquerware bowl.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
Combine the flour, sugar, eggs, milk, and salt in a large bowl, and mix until smooth.
Heat the oil in the deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
Carefully drop the cake mixture into the hot oil, and fry for 2 minutes on each side.
Remove the cake from the oil, and place it on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Repeat the frying process with the remaining cake mixture.
Once the cakes are cool enough to handle, split them in half lengthwise, and sandwich a layer of buttercream in between.
Buttercream: Cook the butter, water, and sugar in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the sugar dissolves.
Add the chopped jalapeno peppers to the saucepan, and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Allow the buttercream to cool to room temperature before using.
Once the cakes are assembled, serve immediately and enjoy!
